# OVT MCP prompts

Authoring scaffolds derived from the typed prompt registry. Each renders to a single user message that directs a host agent to the right operations; none embeds operator data.

## `voice-matched-draft` (m2)

Draft text in the operator's calibrated voice for one context, then mechanically validate it.

| argument | required | description |
|---|---|---|
| `subject_id` | yes | The OPERATOR subject to draft as |
| `consumer_id` | yes | Allowlisted consumer identifier for the bundle request |
| `task` | yes | Plain-language description of what to write |
| `channel` | no | Delivery channel (e.g. email, chat) |
| `audience` | no | Who it is for (e.g. team, exec) |

## `correct-my-voice` (m2)

Record a direct operator correction so it outranks anything OVT inferred.

| argument | required | description |
|---|---|---|
| `subject_id` | yes | The OPERATOR subject being corrected |
| `correction` | yes | What the operator said is wrong, in their own words |

## `external-subject-brief` (m2)

Produce an analysis-only insight brief for an enrolled EXTERNAL subject (never authoring).

| argument | required | description |
|---|---|---|
| `subject_id` | yes | An enrolled EXTERNAL subject id |
| `purpose` | yes | The approved analysis purpose |
